notes.title: Unit Down Charge is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Let everyone know!
The game is now public, which means not just crowdfunding partners can now enjoy the game!  Run, shoot, and dodge through the newest addition to the rail-shooter genre!


Thank you for your support!
It really means the world to me, and your comments kept me driven to finish this project.  I hope you enjoy my lil' passion project!  I am so excited to see ya'll play Unit Down Charge!



Stay Proper,
   - Randy

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44397978/3e8c3f2da15dbb176dd09358e1c2d85160f2bca0.jpg"]
Demo has been updated!
Thanks to player feedback, the newest version now has some major changes:

Enemy fire rates have been increased to provide more challenge.

Gamepad support completely revamped for better control!

Deon's ability and fire rate has been adjusted for balancing.

Lar's slowmo ability now increases his fire-rate as well.

Score staling starts decreasing max score per enemy by a slower rate.

Bosses "Time Bonus" now decreases at a more competitive rate.

Shield Enemy has a more obvious weakspot.

Boss battles have their speed increased at early stages.

And some minor bug fixes.
Thank you for playing my demo and hope to see you at launch!
